source: round 9: prompts written blind by an eighth fresh subagent told the repo file list (the seed in the probe), the tools the assistant has, and the three kinds; it never saw the style text, the hook, any earlier prompt set or any reply. Kinds are its labels. Judge: formP in ../18-8/probe.ts, unchanged since round 5.

prompts.prompt: Deploy the latest build to my production box and restart app.service.
Should the webhook signature check use HMAC-SHA256 or the provider's own scheme? Pick one and wire it into server/webhooks.py.
Add a second migration that adds a deliveries table. I'm not sure whether to key it by UUID or serial int, so ask me, then apply it to my staging database.
run scripts/migrate.sh against prod
Add rate limiting to the webhook endpoint. I haven't decided on the limit per minute or whether it should be per IP or per sender, so check with me first.
Renew the TLS cert for the domain in deploy/nginx.conf with certbot and reload nginx. I'll give you the sudo access you need.
I want to move config from env vars to a secrets manager. Ask me which one I want to use, then set it up and log in to it so the app can read the values.
Which Python version should CI target? Update ci.yml and requirements.txt to match what I tell you.
Push the webhook secret to my GitHub repo's Actions secrets so CI can run the integration tests.
Our nginx config needs a server_name and a upstream port. Ask me what they should be and then install the updated config on the server and reload it.
Where do you want the log files to go? Add file logging to server/app.py and put the path wherever you think is right, but ask me if there is a convention I follow.
Can you ssh into my server and tail the app.service journal to see why webhooks are timing out?
Set up a staging environment alongside prod. Ask me what hostname and branch it should track, then provision it on my server.
Add retry logic for failed webhook deliveries. What backoff and max attempts do I want? Ask me before you write it.
Publish the web build to our CDN bucket. The upload needs my AWS login.
Rotate the webhook signing secret. Ask me whether I want a grace period with both old and new secrets accepted, then update the server's env file and restart the service.
README is thin. What audience is it for, new contributors or ops people? Ask me and rewrite it accordingly.
Install the systemd unit from deploy/app.service on my server and enable it on boot.
I'd like to add auth to the web dashboard. I haven't picked between GitHub OAuth and a simple password, so ask me, then register the OAuth app under my account if needed.
what should the Makefile default target be? i keep going back and forth, just ask me
Roll back the last deploy on the prod server and confirm the service is healthy.
We need to pick a database backend for real, SQLite or Postgres. Ask me which, rewrite migrations/001_init.sql if necessary, and then create the database on my server.
The tests in tests/test_webhooks.py are flaky. Before you change anything, ask me whether I'd rather mock the clock or freeze the payload timestamps.
Log in to npm with my account and publish the web package as a private package.
Wire up Slack notifications on webhook failures. Ask me which channel and whether to use an incoming webhook or a bot, then add the Slack token to the server's environment.
Hey, I want to rename server/webhooks.py to something better. What name do I want? Ask me and update imports and tests.
Open a firewall port for the app on my server so nginx can reach it. You'll need sudo.
Add a /health endpoint and point the load balancer at it. Ask me what the response body should look like, then update the load balancer in my cloud console.
Which Node version should web/package.json pin in engines? Ask me, then set it and update CI.
Run the full CI workflow against my fork using my gh login and tell me which jobs fail.
Time to set up backups for the database. I haven't decided on frequency or retention, so ask me, then add a cron entry on the production machine.
Should webhook payloads be stored raw or parsed? Ask me and make server/webhooks.py match.
